mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_MEM_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId}) AS "memberCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_MEM_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND join_ymd LIKE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), '%')) AS "newMembersThisMonth", P.pay_plan_nm AS "currentPayPlanNm", DATE_FORMAT(S.service_endde, '%Y-%m-%d') AS "serviceEndde" FROM TN_SYS_M001 S LEFT JOIN TN_PAY_M001 P ON S.current_pay_idx = P.idx WHERE S.sys_id = #{sysId}

SELECT idx AS "idx", vote_titl AS "voteTitl", bgng_dt AS "bgngDt", end_dt AS "endDt" FROM TN_VOTE_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND del_yn = 'N' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN bgng_dt AND end_dt ORDER BY end_dt ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT surv_id AS "survId", surv_nm AS "survNm", start_dt AS "startDt", end_dt AS "endDt" FROM TN_SURVEY_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND template_yn = 'N' AND del_yn = 'N' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN start_dt AND end_dt ORDER BY end_dt ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT user_id AS "userId", fnctn_nm AS "fnctnNm", req_url AS "reqUrl", reg_dt AS "regDt" FROM TN_COM_L001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} ORDER BY reg_dt DESC LIMIT 10
